ex.en: She has an oval face.
ex.zh: 她有一張鵝蛋臉。

ex.en: We sat around a large oval table.
ex.zh: 我們圍坐在一張大橢圓桌旁。

oval.en: shaped like an egg or a long circle

ex.en: Draw an oval in the middle of the page.
ex.zh: 在頁面中間畫一個橢圓形。

ex.en: The logo is a blue oval with white letters.
ex.zh: 這個標誌是一個藍色橢圓，裡面有白色字母。

oval.en: a shape like an egg or a long circle

ex.en: We stayed overnight in Hakone.
ex.zh: 我們在箱根住了一晚。

ex.en: Leave the dough in the fridge overnight.
ex.zh: 把麵團放在冰箱裡過夜。

ex.en: English cannot be mastered overnight.
ex.zh: 英文不是一夜之間就能學好的。

ex.en: This saying became popular overnight.
ex.zh: 這句話一夕之間就流行起來了。

ex.en: We took an overnight train to Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 我們搭夜車去高雄。

ex.en: Please send the package by overnight delivery.
ex.zh: 請用隔夜快遞寄送這個包裹。

overnight.en: lasting through the night, or delivered by the next morning

ex.en: This library book is two weeks overdue.
ex.zh: 這本圖書館的書已經逾期兩週了。

ex.en: Please pay the overdue invoice immediately.
ex.zh: 請立即支付這張逾期的帳單。

overdue.en: not paid or returned by the required time

ex.en: A pay raise for the staff is long overdue.
ex.zh: 員工早就該加薪了。

ex.en: The upgrade to the old system is overdue.
ex.zh: 舊系統早該升級了。

overdue.en: late in happening and needed for a long time

ex.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房有烤箱，可以用來烤麵包。

ex.en: Did you remember to turn off the oven?
ex.zh: 你記得關烤箱了嗎？

ex.en: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
ex.zh: 我們該買一台新的微波爐了。

oven.en: a closed box in a kitchen used to cook or heat food

ex.en: Let me give you a brief overview of the project.
ex.zh: 讓我簡單介紹一下這個專案的概況。

ex.en: This report provides an overview of last year's sales.
ex.zh: 這份報告概述了去年的銷售狀況。

overview.en: a short description of the main points of something

ex.en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
ex.zh: 市政府應該補貼固定成本高的產業中的小型企業。

ex.en: Working from home helps reduce overhead.
ex.zh: 在家工作有助於降低營運成本。

overhead.en: the regular costs of running a business

ex.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
ex.zh: 我看到一架直升機從頭頂飛過。

ex.en: Birds were flying overhead.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在頭頂上飛。

overhead.en: above your head, in the sky

ex.en: Please put your bag in the overhead bin.
ex.zh: 請把你的包包放在頭頂的置物櫃。

ex.en: Turn on the overhead light, please.
ex.zh: 請打開天花板的燈。

ex.en: This kind of mistake is easy to overlook.
ex.zh: 這種錯誤很容易被忽略。

ex.en: We have overlooked this important fact.
ex.zh: 我們忽略了這個重要的事實。

ex.en: We can't overlook the cost of shipping.
ex.zh: 我們不能忽略運費。

overlook.en: to fail to see or notice something

ex.en: The window overlooks the courtyard.
ex.zh: 窗戶正對著底下的庭院。

ex.en: Our room overlooks the sea.
ex.zh: 我們的房間可以俯瞰大海。

overlook.en: to have a view of a place from above

ex.en: The taxi driver overcharged us.
ex.zh: 計程車司機多收了我們的錢。

ex.en: I think the restaurant overcharged me.
ex.zh: 我覺得那家餐廳多算了我的錢。

overcharge.en: to ask someone to pay too much money

ex.en: I think we overpaid for this hotel room.
ex.zh: 我覺得這間飯店房間我們付太多錢了。

ex.en: If you overpay your bill, you will get a refund.
ex.zh: 如果帳單多付了，你會收到退款。

overpay.en: to pay more than is necessary

overcrowd.zh: 使過度擁擠（常用 overcrowded 擁擠不堪的）

ex.en: The trains are overcrowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段的火車擠得不得了。

ex.en: Too many tourists overcrowd the old town every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有太多遊客把老城區擠得水洩不通。

overcrowd.en: to fill a place with too many people or things

ex.en: Their two shadows overlap.
ex.zh: 他們倆的影子重疊在一起。

ex.en: Our responsibilities overlap in some areas.
ex.zh: 我們的職責在某些方面有重疊。

overlap.en: to cover part of something else

ex.en: There is some overlap between the two projects.
ex.zh: 這兩個專案有部分重疊。

ex.en: We should avoid overlap between team members' tasks.
ex.zh: 我們應該避免團隊成員的工作重複。

overlap.en: a part that is shared by two things

overwhelm.zh: 使不知所措、使難以承受

ex.en: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你不知所措的。

ex.en: I was overwhelmed by the amount of work.
ex.zh: 工作量多到讓我喘不過氣。

overwhelm.en: to make someone feel too much emotion or pressure

ex.en: The website was overwhelmed with orders.
ex.zh: 網站被大量訂單塞爆了。

ex.en: Customer calls overwhelmed the help desk.
ex.zh: 大量客戶來電讓服務台應接不暇。

overwhelm.en: to be so much that it cannot be dealt with

ex.en: He reprimanded me for my oversight.
ex.zh: 他責備我的疏忽。

ex.en: Due to an oversight, your order was not shipped.
ex.zh: 由於我們的疏忽，您的訂單沒有出貨。

oversight.en: a mistake made by not noticing something

ex.en: The committee has oversight of the budget.
ex.zh: 委員會負責監督預算。

ex.en: The project needs better oversight.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要更好的監督。

oversight.en: the job of watching and controlling an activity

ex.en: The government plans to overhaul the tax system.
ex.zh: 政府計劃全面改革稅制。

ex.en: The engine was overhauled last month.
ex.zh: 引擎上個月徹底檢修過。

overhaul.en: to check and repair something completely, or change it greatly

ex.en: The website needs a complete overhaul.
ex.zh: 這個網站需要全面翻新。

ex.en: The company announced a major overhaul of its pricing.
ex.zh: 公司宣布大幅調整定價方式。

overhaul.en: a complete check, repair or big change

ex.en: It is hard to overstate the importance of good communication.
ex.zh: 良好溝通的重要性再怎麼強調都不為過。

ex.en: The report overstated the company's profits.
ex.zh: 這份報告誇大了公司的獲利。

overstate.en: to say that something is bigger or more important than it is

ex.en: There is a bridge over the river.
ex.zh: 河上有一座橋。

ex.en: The plane flew over the mountains.
ex.zh: 飛機飛越群山。

over.en: above something, or from one side to the other

ex.en: The meeting is over.
ex.zh: 會議結束了。

ex.en: The game was over at nine.
ex.zh: 比賽九點結束。

ex.en: Over 100 people attended the event.
ex.zh: 超過一百人參加了這場活動。

ex.en: The trip cost over 30,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行花了三萬多元。

over.en: more than a number or amount

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年來，我們經歷了許多改變。

ex.en: Let's talk over a cup of tea, shall we?
ex.zh: 我們邊喝茶邊聊，好嗎？

over.en: during a period of time, or while having a meal or drink

ex.en: English is a language spoken all over the world.
ex.zh: 英語是全世界通用的語言。

ex.en: English is taught almost all over the world today.
ex.zh: 如今世界各地幾乎都在教英語。

over.en: in every part of a place

ex.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這部電影從劇本到大銀幕都很成功。

ex.en: Overall, the trip was a great success.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這趟旅行很成功。

ex.en: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
ex.zh: 應用程式的架構和它的整體效能直接相關。

ex.en: The overall cost of the project is two million dollars.
ex.zh: 這個專案的總成本是兩百萬元。

ex.en: He helped me to overcome the difficulties.
ex.zh: 他幫助我克服了困難。

ex.en: You have to overcome the difficulties.
ex.zh: 你必須克服困難。

ex.en: She helped him overcome his sadness.
ex.zh: 她幫助他走出悲傷。

overcome.en: to deal with a problem and defeat it

ex.en: Do you plan to go overseas?
ex.zh: 你打算出國嗎？

ex.en: I was overseas at the time.
ex.zh: 我當時人在國外。

ex.en: His music has attained great popularity overseas.
ex.zh: 他的音樂在國外大受歡迎。

overseas.en: in or to a foreign country across the sea

ex.en: I'd like to make an overseas call.
ex.zh: 我想打一通國際電話。

ex.en: The company is expanding into overseas markets.
ex.zh: 公司正在拓展海外市場。

overseas.en: in or from a foreign country across the sea

ex.en: The car engine overheated on the highway.
ex.zh: 汽車引擎在高速公路上過熱了。

ex.en: Don't leave your laptop on the bed, or it may overheat.
ex.zh: 別把筆電放在床上，不然可能會過熱。

overheat.en: to become too hot, or make something too hot

ex.en: Experts warn that the housing market may overheat.
ex.zh: 專家警告房市可能會過熱。

ex.en: The central bank raised rates to keep the economy from overheating.
ex.zh: 央行升息以防止經濟過熱。

overheat.en: to grow too fast so that problems may follow

ex.en: She was worn out from overwork.
ex.zh: 她因為工作過度而筋疲力盡。

ex.en: Overwork is a common cause of stress and illness.
ex.zh: 過勞是造成壓力和疾病的常見原因。

overwork.en: the state of working too hard

ex.en: Managers should be careful not to overwork their staff.
ex.zh: 主管應該留意不要讓員工工作過度。

ex.en: You look tired; you've been overworking yourself.
ex.zh: 你看起來很累，你最近太操勞了。

overwork.en: to make someone work too hard

ex.en: The food was good but overpriced.
ex.zh: 東西好吃，但價格太高了。

ex.en: Hotels near the station are often overpriced.
ex.zh: 車站附近的飯店常常貴得不合理。

overpriced.en: costing more than it is worth

over-the-counter.zh: 不需處方就能買的（成藥）

ex.en: You can buy this painkiller over-the-counter.
ex.zh: 這種止痛藥不需處方就能買。

ex.en: Over-the-counter cold medicine may make you sleepy.
ex.zh: 成藥類的感冒藥可能會讓人想睡。

over-the-counter.en: sold without a doctor's written order

ex.en: All of a sudden the sky became overcast.
ex.zh: 天空突然轉陰了。

ex.en: It was overcast yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天是陰天。

ex.en: I have a small overdraft on my account.
ex.zh: 我的帳戶有一點透支。

ex.en: The bank charges a fee for overdrafts.
ex.zh: 銀行會對透支收費。

overdraft.en: money taken from a bank account that is more than the money in it

ex.en: We must not overspend on office renovations.
ex.zh: 辦公室整修不能超出預算。

ex.en: The department overspent its travel budget last year.
ex.zh: 該部門去年差旅費超支了。

overspend.en: to spend more money than you planned or have

ex.en: An administrator can override the default setting.
ex.zh: 管理員可以覆寫預設設定。

ex.en: The safety rule overrides the manager's instruction.
ex.zh: 安全規範優先於主管的指示。

override.en: to cancel or replace a rule or decision with another

ex.en: My suitcase is overweight, so I have to pay an extra fee.
ex.zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以得付額外的費用。

ex.en: Overweight bags must be repacked before check-in.
ex.zh: 超重的行李必須在報到前重新整理。

ex.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
ex.zh: 69%的美國成人超重或肥胖。

ex.en: I know that Tom is a little overweight.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆有點過重。

overweight.en: heavier than is healthy for your body

ex.en: The flight was overbooked, so some passengers had to take a later one.
ex.zh: 這班飛機超賣了，所以有些乘客只好改搭晚一點的班機。

ex.en: Airlines sometimes offer vouchers when a flight is overbooked.
ex.zh: 航班超賣時，航空公司有時會提供抵用券。

overbooked.en: to accept more reservations than there are seats or rooms available

ex.en: Use the overpass to cross the highway.
ex.zh: 請走天橋過高速公路。

ex.en: There's a bus stop under the overpass.
ex.zh: 天橋下有一個公車站。

overpass.en: a bridge that carries a road or path over another road

ex.en: If you overstay your visa, you may be fined.
ex.zh: 如果簽證逾期停留，你可能會被罰款。

ex.en: He was deported for overstaying his visa.
ex.zh: 他因為簽證逾期停留而被驅逐出境。

overstay.en: to stay longer than you are allowed to

ex.en: She oversees a team of twenty people.
ex.zh: 她督導一個二十人的團隊。

ex.en: An engineer will oversee the construction.
ex.zh: 會有一位工程師監督施工。

oversee.en: to watch work and make sure it is done well

ex.en: The project had a cost overrun of 20%.
ex.zh: 這個專案超支了 20%。

ex.en: We need to avoid any more overruns.
ex.zh: 我們必須避免再超支。

overrun.en: the amount by which cost or time goes beyond the plan

overrun.zh: 超過（時間、預算）；侵占、蔓延

ex.en: The meeting overran by half an hour.
ex.zh: 會議超時了半小時。

ex.en: The garden was overrun with weeds.
ex.zh: 花園裡雜草叢生。

overrun.en: to go beyond a limit, or to spread over a place in large numbers

ex.en: I'm afraid you have to work overtime.
ex.zh: 恐怕你要加班了。

ex.en: I had to work overtime yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天必須加班。

ex.en: My boss made me work overtime.
ex.zh: 老闆要我加班。

overtime.en: for more hours than the normal working time

ex.en: Jia-hao said he's not coming today. He has a last-minute overtime.
ex.zh: 家豪說他今天不來了，臨時要加班。

ex.en: Do you get paid for overtime?
ex.zh: 你加班有加班費嗎？

overtime.en: extra hours of work, or the pay for them

ex.en: The team won the game by an overwhelming margin.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍以壓倒性的差距贏得比賽。

ex.en: The work felt overwhelming during the first week of the new job.
ex.zh: 新工作的第一週，工作量讓人難以承受。

ex.en: There was overwhelming support for the new plan.
ex.zh: 新計畫獲得壓倒性的支持。

ex.en: It is dangerous to overtake a truck on a narrow road.
ex.zh: 在窄路上超越卡車很危險。

ex.en: She overtook two runners in the last lap.
ex.zh: 她在最後一圈超越了兩名跑者。

ex.en: Sales of online books may soon overtake sales of printed books.
ex.zh: 網路書籍的銷量可能很快就會趕上紙本書。

ex.en: China has overtaken Japan as the world's second-largest economy by some measures.
ex.zh: 就某些指標而言，中國已超越日本成為世界第二大經濟體。

ex.en: Darkness overtook the hikers before they reached the camp.
ex.zh: 在抵達營地之前，夜幕突然籠罩了登山客。

ex.en: A sudden wave of sleepiness overtook him at his desk.
ex.zh: 他在書桌前突然被一陣睡意襲來。

ex.en: Don't be overly worried about the test.
ex.zh: 不要對考試過度擔心。

ex.en: The soup was overly salty, so I couldn't finish it.
ex.zh: 這碗湯太鹹了，所以我喝不完。

ex.en: He is overly polite, which sometimes makes people uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他禮貌得過了頭，有時反而讓人不自在。

ex.en: The court may overturn the earlier decision.
ex.zh: 法院可能會推翻先前的判決。

ex.en: The new rule was overturned after many complaints.
ex.zh: 在許多人抱怨後，這項新規定被撤銷了。

ex.en: A strong wave overturned the small boat.
ex.zh: 一陣大浪使那艘小船翻覆了。

ex.en: The truck overturned on the icy road.
ex.zh: 卡車在結冰的路面上翻覆。

ex.en: Be careful not to overturn the vase.
ex.zh: 小心別把花瓶打翻了。

ex.en: The students voted overwhelmingly in favor of a shorter school day.
ex.zh: 學生們以壓倒性的票數贊成縮短上課時間。

ex.en: The response to our campaign was overwhelmingly positive.
ex.zh: 大家對我們活動的反應非常正面。

ex.en: There was no overt sign of trouble at the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議上沒有任何明顯的麻煩跡象。

ex.en: The company made an overt attempt to attract younger customers.
ex.zh: 這家公司公開地努力吸引年輕顧客。

ex.en: I accidentally overheard them talking about a surprise party.
ex.zh: 我不小心聽到他們在討論驚喜派對。

ex.en: She overheard her neighbors arguing through the wall.
ex.zh: 她隔著牆無意中聽到鄰居在吵架。

ex.en: Don't talk about it here; someone might overhear us.
ex.zh: 別在這裡談這件事，可能會被人聽到。

ex.en: The people tried to overthrow the unfair government.
ex.zh: 人民試圖推翻不公平的政府。

ex.en: The rebels planned to overthrow the king.
ex.zh: 叛軍計畫推翻國王。

ex.en: The overthrow of the old system took many years.
ex.zh: 推翻舊制度花了許多年。

ex.en: Historians still discuss the overthrow of the empire.
ex.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在討論這個帝國的覆亡。

ex.en: The river overflowed after three days of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 連下三天大雨後，河水氾濫了。

ex.en: Don't fill the glass too much or the water will overflow.
ex.zh: 杯子別裝太滿，不然水會溢出來。

ex.en: Workers cleaned up the overflow from the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 工人清理了破裂水管溢出的水。

ex.en: The extra guests sat in the overflow room next door.
ex.zh: 多出來的賓客坐在隔壁的備用空間。

ex.en: The stadium overflowed with excited fans.
ex.zh: 體育場擠滿了興奮的球迷。

ex.en: Her heart overflowed with joy at the news.
ex.zh: 聽到這個消息，她心中充滿喜悅。

ex.en: Her sister's success tends to overshadow her own work.
ex.zh: 她姊姊的成功往往讓她自己的成果相形失色。

ex.en: Sadness overshadowed the happy day.
ex.zh: 悲傷蒙上了這個快樂日子的陰影。

ex.en: Tall buildings overshadow the small garden.
ex.zh: 高樓遮住了那座小花園的陽光。

ex.en: Safety is our overriding concern on every trip.
ex.zh: 安全是我們每趟旅程最優先的考量。

ex.en: Her overriding goal was to finish school and get a good job.
ex.zh: 她最重要的目標是完成學業並找到好工作。

overriding.zh: 推翻、凌駕（override 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The manager is overriding the system's default settings.
ex.zh: 經理正在覆蓋系統的預設設定。

ex.en: Overriding the earlier decision would upset many people.
ex.zh: 推翻先前的決定會讓很多人不高興。

ex.en: He wore a long overcoat on the cold morning.
ex.zh: 寒冷的早晨他穿著一件長大衣。

ex.en: I left my overcoat on the chair at the restaurant.
ex.zh: 我把大衣留在餐廳的椅子上了。

ex.en: He fell overboard during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中他掉到了船外。

ex.en: The sailors threw the heavy boxes overboard.
ex.zh: 水手們把沉重的箱子丟到船外。

ex.en: Don't go overboard with the decorations.
ex.zh: 裝飾不要弄得太過火了。

ex.en: She went overboard with her birthday party plans.
ex.zh: 她把生日派對的計畫搞得太誇張了。

ex.en: He wore an oversized sweater on the cold day.
ex.zh: 天氣冷的那天他穿了一件特大號毛衣。

ex.en: The oversized box wouldn't fit in the car.
ex.zh: 那個特大的箱子塞不進車裡。

ex.en: The two classes have overlapping schedules, so I can't take both.
ex.zh: 這兩堂課的時間重疊，所以我沒辦法兩門都修。

ex.en: The roof is made of overlapping tiles.
ex.zh: 屋頂是由相互重疊的瓦片鋪成的。

ex.en: The trains are overcrowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段的火車過度擁擠。

ex.en: The city has many overcrowded schools.
ex.zh: 這座城市有許多過度擁擠的學校。

ex.en: His speech had political overtones that worried some people.
ex.zh: 他的演說帶有政治意味，讓一些人感到擔心。

ex.en: I noticed a hint of sadness in the overtones of her message.
ex.zh: 我在她訊息的字裡行間察覺到一絲悲傷。

ex.en: A violin produces many overtones that give it a rich sound.
ex.zh: 小提琴會產生許多泛音，讓聲音更豐富。

ex.en: The teacher explained how overtones affect a note's color.
ex.zh: 老師說明了泛音如何影響音色。

ex.en: The judge overruled the lawyer's objection.
ex.zh: 法官駁回了律師的異議。

ex.en: The board overruled the manager's plan.
ex.zh: 董事會否決了經理的計畫。

ex.en: The map has a transparent overlay showing bus routes.
ex.zh: 這張地圖有一層透明的疊加圖層，標示公車路線。

ex.en: Add an overlay of text on the photo.
ex.zh: 在照片上加一層文字覆蓋。

ex.en: They overlay the wooden floor with a thin carpet.
ex.zh: 他們在木地板上鋪了一層薄地毯。

ex.en: The artist overlays gold paint on the dark background.
ex.zh: 畫家在深色背景上覆蓋一層金色顏料。

ex.en: He never overtly criticized the boss in meetings.
ex.zh: 他從不在會議上公開批評老闆。

ex.en: The ad was overtly aimed at young people.
ex.zh: 這則廣告明顯是針對年輕人。

ex.en: The guards managed to overpower the thief.
ex.zh: 警衛成功制伏了小偷。

ex.en: The strong smell of paint began to overpower the room.
ex.zh: 油漆的刺鼻味開始充滿整個房間。

ex.en: Our team couldn't overpower such a strong opponent.
ex.zh: 我們的隊伍無法壓倒如此強大的對手。

ex.en: The doctor warned about the danger of an overdose.
ex.zh: 醫生警告了用藥過量的危險。

ex.en: Keep medicine away from children to prevent an accidental overdose.
ex.zh: 把藥放在小孩拿不到的地方，以免意外服用過量。

ex.en: Never overdose on pain medicine, even if the pain is strong.
ex.zh: 即使很痛，也絕對不要服用過量的止痛藥。

ex.en: The patient overdosed and was rushed to the hospital.
ex.zh: 病患服藥過量，被緊急送往醫院。

ex.en: Don't overestimate how much you can finish in one day.
ex.zh: 別高估自己一天能完成多少事。

ex.en: They overestimated the number of guests who would come.
ex.zh: 他們高估了會來的賓客人數。

ex.en: His estimate of the cost was a big overestimate.
ex.zh: 他對成本的估計高出了很多。

ex.en: That figure is probably an overestimate.
ex.zh: 那個數字大概是估得太高了。

ex.en: The singer received a standing ovation.
ex.zh: 歌手獲得了全場起立鼓掌。

ex.en: The crowd gave the team a warm ovation.
ex.zh: 群眾向球隊報以熱烈的掌聲。

ex.en: The orchestra opened the show with a lively overture.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團以一首輕快的序曲揭開演出序幕。

ex.en: The overture introduces the main themes of the opera.
ex.zh: 序曲介紹了這部歌劇的主要旋律。

ex.en: The company made an overture to its old rival about a partnership.
ex.zh: 這家公司主動向老對手提議合作。

ex.en: She ignored his friendly overtures.
ex.zh: 她無視他主動示好的舉動。

ex.en: Don't overdo the salt, or the soup will taste too strong.
ex.zh: 鹽別放太多，不然湯會太鹹。

ex.en: He overdid his workout and could barely walk the next day.
ex.zh: 他運動過量，隔天幾乎走不了路。

ex.en: Don't overload the truck, or it may break down.
ex.zh: 別讓貨車超載，否則可能會拋錨。

ex.en: Too many plugs can overload the electrical circuit.
ex.zh: 插太多插頭可能會讓電路過載。

ex.en: I feel information overload when I read the news all day.
ex.zh: 整天看新聞讓我覺得資訊爆量。

ex.en: A power overload caused the lights to go out.
ex.zh: 電力過載造成燈光熄滅。

overwhelmed.zh: 不知所措的、喘不過氣的

ex.en: I feel overwhelmed by all the homework this week.
ex.zh: 這週的作業多到讓我喘不過氣。

ex.en: The new teacher was overwhelmed on her first day.
ex.zh: 新老師第一天就被搞得不知所措。

ex.en: A huge crowd overwhelmed the small ticket office.
ex.zh: 大批人潮讓小小的售票處應接不暇。

ex.en: Grief overwhelmed her when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時被悲傷淹沒。

ex.en: Please don't overreact to a small mistake.
ex.zh: 請不要對一個小錯誤反應過度。

ex.en: Parents sometimes overreact when their children get hurt.
ex.zh: 孩子受傷時，父母有時會反應過度。

ex.en: The doctor ordered a test for ovarian problems.
ex.zh: 醫生安排了卵巢方面的檢查。

ex.en: Regular checkups help find ovarian cysts early.
ex.zh: 定期檢查有助於及早發現卵巢囊腫。

ex.en: The overworked nurses barely had time to eat.
ex.zh: 工作過度的護理師們幾乎沒時間吃飯。

ex.en: I feel tired and overworked this week.
ex.zh: 我這週覺得又累又操勞過度。

ex.en: The ovary produces eggs in the female body.
ex.zh: 卵巢在女性體內產生卵子。

ex.en: A woman has two ovaries, one on each side.
ex.zh: 女性有兩個卵巢，左右各一。

ex.en: The overarching goal of the project is to cut waste.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的首要目標是減少浪費。

ex.en: We need an overarching plan before choosing details.
ex.zh: 在決定細節之前，我們需要一個整體的規劃。

ex.en: We sheltered under the overhanging rock during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨時，我們躲在突出的岩石下。

ex.en: The overhanging branches blocked the narrow path.
ex.zh: 垂在上方的樹枝擋住了窄路。

ex.en: He wore an oversize sweater on the cold morning.
ex.zh: 那個寒冷的早晨，他穿著一件特大號的毛衣。

ex.en: The oversize box would not fit through the door.
ex.zh: 那個特大的箱子塞不進門。

ex.en: The garden was overgrown after months without care.
ex.zh: 幾個月沒人照料，花園雜草叢生。

ex.en: We followed an overgrown path through the woods.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一條雜草叢生的小徑穿過樹林。

ex.en: The overgrown puppy still thinks it can sit on my lap.
ex.zh: 那隻長得太大的小狗還以為自己可以坐在我腿上。

ex.en: He felt like an overgrown child at the small desk.
ex.zh: 坐在那張小書桌前，他覺得自己像個長得太大的孩子。

ex.en: The overseer checked the workers' progress each hour.
ex.zh: 監工每小時檢查工人的進度。

ex.en: An overseer walked the fields to make sure the harvest was on time.
ex.zh: 一位監督者巡視田地，確保收成準時完成。

ex.en: We stood under the overhang to avoid the rain.
ex.zh: 我們站在突出的屋簷下躲雨。

ex.en: The cliff has a large overhang above the path.
ex.zh: 懸崖上方有一大塊突出的岩壁罩在步道上。

ex.en: The branches overhang the fence from the neighbor's yard.
ex.zh: 樹枝從鄰居院子懸伸到圍籬上。

ex.en: Dark clouds overhang the valley this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上烏雲籠罩著山谷。

ex.en: The villagers paid taxes to the local overlord.
ex.zh: 村民向當地的領主繳稅。

ex.en: In the story, the evil overlord ruled the whole land.
ex.zh: 故事中，邪惡的霸主統治整片土地。

ex.en: Don't overdrive yourself before the big exam.
ex.zh: 大考前不要讓自己過度勞累。

ex.en: The farmer refused to overdrive his tired horses.
ex.zh: 農夫不肯再過度驅使疲憊的馬。

overdrive.zh: 超速檔；極度忙碌的狀態

ex.en: The car shifted into overdrive on the highway.
ex.zh: 車子在高速公路上切換成超速檔。

ex.en: Our team went into overdrive to finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 我們團隊全力衝刺，好讓專案準時完成。

ex.en: The newspaper's praise seemed overblown to me.
ex.zh: 我覺得報紙的稱讚有些言過其實。

ex.en: Critics said the film's drama was overblown and silly.
ex.zh: 評論家說這部電影的戲劇性太浮誇又愚蠢。

ex.en: Please sign the form and see the instructions overleaf.
ex.zh: 請在表格上簽名，並參閱背面的說明。

ex.en: The answers are printed overleaf.
ex.zh: 答案印在下一頁背面。

ex.en: The overheated engine started to smoke on the highway.
ex.zh: 過熱的引擎在高速公路上開始冒煙。

ex.en: It was an overheated room full of people and no fresh air.
ex.zh: 那是一間擠滿人、空氣不流通又悶熱的房間。

ex.en: My laptop overheated while I was watching videos.
ex.zh: 我看影片的時候筆電過熱了。

ex.en: The motor overheated because the fan had stopped working.
ex.zh: 馬達因為風扇停止運轉而過熱。

overpowering.zh: 強烈得令人受不了的；壓倒性的

ex.en: The overpowering smell of paint made me feel dizzy.
ex.zh: 油漆那股濃烈到受不了的味道讓我頭暈。

ex.en: She felt an overpowering urge to laugh.
ex.zh: 她有一股無法抑制的笑意。

ex.en: If you don't trim the bushes, they will overgrow the path.
ex.zh: 如果你不修剪灌木，它們會長滿小徑。

ex.en: Weeds quickly overgrow a garden that no one takes care of.
ex.zh: 沒人照顧的花園，雜草很快就會長得到處都是。

ex.en: It's easy to overeat at a holiday buffet.
ex.zh: 在節慶自助餐吃太多很容易。

ex.en: I tend to overeat when I'm stressed.
ex.zh: 我壓力大時常會吃太多。

ex.en: An overzealous guard stopped every visitor at the gate.
ex.zh: 一位過度熱心的警衛攔下每位到訪者。

ex.en: The overzealous salesman wouldn't leave us alone.
ex.zh: 那位過度殷勤的業務員一直纏著我們不放。

ex.en: She was overjoyed to see her brother again.
ex.zh: 她再見到哥哥時欣喜若狂。

ex.en: We were overjoyed by the good news.
ex.zh: 我們聽到好消息都樂壞了。

ex.en: I think that movie is overrated.
ex.zh: 我覺得那部電影被高估了。

ex.en: Some people say the famous restaurant is overrated.
ex.zh: 有些人說那家名店徒有虛名。

ex.en: My laptop keeps overheating when I play games.
ex.zh: 我一玩遊戲，筆電就一直過熱。

ex.en: The engine is overheating, so we should stop the car.
ex.zh: 引擎過熱了，我們應該把車停下來。

ex.en: Doctors warn that people overuse antibiotics.
ex.zh: 醫生警告說，人們過度使用抗生素。

ex.en: If you overuse this word, your writing will sound boring.
ex.zh: 如果你過度使用這個字，文章會顯得乏味。

ex.en: Overuse of the machine can shorten its life.
ex.zh: 過度使用這台機器會縮短它的壽命。

ex.en: The injury was caused by overuse of the knee.
ex.zh: 這個傷是膝蓋過度使用造成的。

ex.en: His overbearing manner made the team uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他專橫的態度讓團隊很不自在。

ex.en: She had an overbearing boss who never listened.
ex.zh: 她有一位從不聽人說話的跋扈老闆。

ex.en: Overpopulation can lead to shortages of food and water.
ex.zh: 人口過剩可能導致糧食和水不足。

ex.en: The city suffers from overpopulation and heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 這座城市有人口過剩和交通壅塞的問題。

overstuffed.zh: 塞得太滿的；填充得鬆軟的

ex.en: I tripped over her overstuffed suitcase in the hallway.
ex.zh: 我在走廊被她塞得滿滿的行李箱絆倒。

ex.en: They sat on an overstuffed sofa and watched TV.
ex.zh: 他們坐在又軟又厚的沙發上看電視。

ex.en: Sorry, I think I overstepped by reading your messages.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我想我看了你的訊息是越界了。

ex.en: Managers must not overstep the limits of their authority.
ex.zh: 主管不得逾越自己的職權範圍。

ex.en: The referee warned him not to overstep the line again.
ex.zh: 裁判警告他別再踩過那條線。
